import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long sn = 10000000;
        long sd = 1;

        for (int den = 1; den <= n; den++) {
            double ap = (double) x * den / y;
            long num = (long) ap;
            if (ap - num > 0.5) {
                num++;
            }
            long lhs = (long) ((y * den) * Math.abs(x * sd - sn * y));
            long rhs = (long) ((y * sd) * Math.abs(x * den - num * y));
            if (lhs > rhs) {
                sn = num;
                sd = den;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(sn + "/" + sd);
        sc.close();
    }
}
